category: Protect All Forms of Code from Unauthorized Access and Tampering (PS)
subcategory_text: Store all forms of code (source, build scripts, configuration, infrastructure-as-code) in a version-control system with appropriate access controls. Restrict who can read, modify, or push code based on the principle of least privilege.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-3, AC-6, CM-5, SC-28
implementation_examples: Use protected branches and pull-request reviews for all production-bound code
Apply branch protection rules that require reviews and signed commits
assessment_objectives: Determine whether code is stored in version-controlled repositories.
Determine whether code access follows the principle of least privilege.
